description: Draw a map (regions of one country, or countries of the world) next to a bar chart of the top places, in matching colours, as one image. Easier to read than a map alone: the bars give the exact numbers. Use region names or ISO codes as 'name'. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

country.description: For regions of one country, e.g. 'DE'. Leave out for a world map of countries.

data.description: One row per region or country.

top.description: How many places the bar chart ranks (default 10).

name: generate_map_ranking
title: Map with a top-10 ranking
